meta.machine: Apple M4, 4 performance + 6 efficiency cores, 16 GB

tso_on.what: all three ordering switches on: the like-for-like comparison with Rosetta 2

tso_scalar.what: ordering for scalar accesses only (FEX's defaults for the vector and string switches)

tso_vector.what: scalar and vector ordering, string instructions without

tso_memcpy.what: scalar and string-instruction ordering, vectors without

tso_on_x87rp.what: all ordering on, x87 in 64-bit precision

tso_off.what: no ordering emulation: not correct for multi-threaded guests; an upper bound for guests known not to need it

tso_on_cache_cold.what: as tso_on, with the code cache on in a fresh, empty directory for every launch: everything is compiled and written to the cache

tso_on_cache_warm.what: as tso_on, with the code cache on in a directory one run with the same arguments filled first: translations are loaded, not compiled

load.method: host_processor_info CPU ticks minus this script's own CPU time (getrusage, proc_pid_rusage)
